name: Smooth Motion
description: Generates frames for the display refresh rate or a fixed target frame rate.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.description: Generates frames to the detected display refresh rate.

settings.label: Motion interpolation
settings.description: Generate intermediate frames with minterpolate. Disable to leave the video at its source rate.

settings.label: Interpolation quality
settings.description: Smooth uses motion-compensated interpolation; Fast uses less CPU.

info:
Generates frames with mpv minterpolate.
Open Statistics (I), then press its number key (usually 2).
Settings chooses display/fixed FPS and MCI/Blend quality.
Requires mpv raw access; MCI is CPU-heavy.
